bio_text: Era Qian is co-founder of Edge (EdgeAGI) and Open Source Campus, an applied AI R&D lab co-founded with Transformer paper author Lukasz Kaiser, focused on edge intelligence, sovereign AI, and open-source community building in San Francisco. She brings a rare combination of deep-tech operator instincts and institutional finance experience, having previously led digital asset investments at Matrix Capital Management and Galaxy Digital. She is a vocal advocate for on-device AI, privacy-preserving hardware, and composable open-source infrastructure, and is embedded in the frontier AI community as an organizer, emcee, and mentor.
